value.rationale: Revised both replaceable components conservatively. Explicit noncash media such as “in hay” are preserved; missing media and unstated times remain unread. Payment-purpose links now use the actual observed service ID and require clause-local agreement on payer/employer, recipient/worker, and service kind. Prompts preserve separately enumerated, oppositely directed payment/service rows and prohibit transferring service periods to payments or inferring home from domestic work.
